skills.name: pick_place
skills.summary: Grasp one movable object, carry it to a site or support object, release, and verify the placement and release.
preconditions: if target is a closed drawer region, the drawer is open first
skills.completion: native goal atom true, target relation true after release, release opening >= 0.05 m, observation newer than release

skills.name: open_drawer
skills.summary: Open one cabinet drawer level and verify the joint reaches the open range.
preconditions: candidate is a cabinet drawer region

skills.name: push_object
skills.summary: Push one rigid object along the table to a target site. No grasp and no release verification.
skills.completion: native goal atom true and object displacement > 0.03 m

skills.name: turn_on
skills.summary: Turn on an articulated appliance by its control. No grasp and no release verification.

skills.name: whole_task
skills.summary: Run the resident whole-task policy on the full official instruction and let it produce the trajectory. Used only when the selected action-model backend is a whole-task policy (OpenWAM).
preconditions: action_model.backend is openwam and its resident server is reachable
prompt is the exact official LIBERO instruction, not a sub-skill prompt
skills.completion: native LIBERO goal latched from a measured observation; measured gripper separation recorded as release evidence
